ns2:section.sectionText: TOPIC: “The Art of Beatmaking II." This course is the second course in the School of Music's Beatmaking course sequence and gives students an opportunity to explore further urban and popular music beatmaking (traditionally referred to as instrumental music composition) from a lens of analysis, creativity, and technical understanding. Students work directly with a music industry professional to apply their creative and technical understanding to produce original music of their own. NOTE: This course is for experienced DAW users.
